name: SYNDRO_SURV_EVENT_ENCS
description: Contains the encounters associated with syndromic surveillance events.

columns.name: SYNDRO_SURV_EVENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the syndromic surveillance event record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_DATE
columns.description: The date of the encounter that met the syndrome criteria.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The unique contact serial number (CSN) for the encounter that met the syndrome criteria.
